records.literal_gloss: And spoke David to YHWH the words of this song on [the] day YHWH delivered him from [the] palm of all his enemies and from [the] palm of Saul.

en.L: And David spoke to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the words of this song on the day [when] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} delivered him from the palm of all his enemies and from the palm of Saul.
en.B: David sang the words of this song to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} on the day {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rescued him from the power of all his enemies and from the power of Saul.
en.R: David sang this song to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} saved him from all his enemies, and from Saul.

es.L: Y David dijo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} las palabras de este cántico el día [en que] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo libró de la palma de todos sus enemigos y de la palma de Saúl.
es.B: David cantó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} las palabras de este cántico el día en que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo rescató del poder de todos sus enemigos y del poder de Saúl.
es.R: David le cantó este canto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo salvó de todos sus enemigos y de Saúl.

fr.L: Et David adressa {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} les paroles de ce cantique le jour [où] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le délivra de la paume de tous ses ennemis et de la paume de Saül.
fr.B: David chanta {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} les paroles de ce cantique le jour où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le délivra du pouvoir de tous ses ennemis et du pouvoir de Saül.
fr.R: David a chanté ce chant {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a sauvé de tous ses ennemis, et de Saül.

sw.L: Daudi akamwambia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} maneno ya wimbo huu siku ile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipomwokoa kutoka katika kiganja cha adui zake wote na kutoka katika kiganja cha Sauli.
sw.B: Daudi alimwimbia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} maneno ya wimbo huu siku ile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipomwokoa kutoka katika mamlaka ya adui zake wote na kutoka katika mamlaka ya Sauli.
sw.R: Daudi alimwimbia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wimbo huu wakati {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipomwokoa kutoka kwa adui zake wote, na kutoka kwa Sauli.

vi.L: Đa-vít nói với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} những lời của bài ca này vào ngày {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giải cứu ông khỏi lòng bàn tay của mọi kẻ thù và khỏi lòng bàn tay của Sau-lơ.
vi.B: Đa-vít hát những lời của bài ca này cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vào ngày {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giải cứu ông khỏi quyền lực của mọi kẻ thù và khỏi quyền lực của Sau-lơ.
vi.R: Đa-vít hát bài ca này cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cứu ông khỏi mọi kẻ thù và khỏi Sau-lơ.

ko.L: 다윗이 이 노래의 말을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 아뢰었는데, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 그의 모든 원수의 손바닥과 사울의 손바닥에서 건지신 날이었다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다윗을 그의 모든 원수의 손과 사울의 손에서 건져 주신 날, 다윗이 이 노래를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 불러 드렸다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다윗을 모든 원수에게서, 그리고 사울에게서 구해 주셨을 때, 다윗이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 이 노래를 불러 드렸다.

pt.L: E Davi falou {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} as palavras deste cântico no dia [em que] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} o livrou da mão de todos os seus inimigos e da mão de Saul.
pt.B: Davi cantou {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} as palavras deste cântico no dia em que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} o livrou do poder de todos os seus inimigos e do poder de Saul.
pt.R: Davi cantou este cântico {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} quando {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} o salvou de todos os seus inimigos e de Saul.

decisions.reason: This song is also found, with small differences, as Psalm 18. Its wording here follows Psalm 18 wherever the Hebrew is the same, and each verse names where the two differ. Here, near the end of David's story, it looks back over all his wars (chapters 5, 8, 10 and 21), before his last words in 23:1-7.

Psalm 18:1 is a title: "For the director. Of the servant of the LORD, of David, who spoke ...". Here the narrator says "And David spoke". The psalm also has "from the hand of Saul" where this verse repeats "from the palm".

decisions.choice: the palm of all his enemies: their power
decisions.reason: The palm and the hand stand for power and control.

decisions.choice: and from Saul: the enemy of David's early years
decisions.reason: Saul hunted David for years (1 Samuel 18-26). He is named apart from the other enemies because he was Israel's king and the LORD's anointed, whom David would not harm (1 Samuel 24:7).
The verb means to speak, but what David spoke was a song; Balanced and Readable say "sang", as at Psalm 18:1.

decisions.choice: the French wording of Psalm 18 reused at each level wherever the Hebrew is the same
decisions.reason: This song is Psalm 18 (m1). As the Samuel terms note asks, each level takes the published French of Psalm 18 where the Hebrew agrees, and follows the English and the meaning decisions on each difference ("la paume de Saül" here, where the psalm has "la main"). Here, as in the Psalm, "ce cantique" at Literal and Balanced, "ce chant" at Readable.

decisions.choice: the wording of the published Spanish Psalm 18, set in lines as the English
decisions.reason: This song is Psalm 18. Where the Hebrew is the same, each level reuses the published Spanish Psalm 18 at that level; where 2 Samuel differs, the Spanish follows the English record and its decisions. The lines follow the English \q breaks.

decisions.choice: the wording of the Swahili Psalm 18
decisions.reason: This song is Psalm 18; each level reuses the published Swahili Psalm 18 wording wherever the Hebrew is the same and follows the English decisions where it differs. Unlike the Swahili Psalm 18, the song is set in lines here, because the English levels of 2 Samuel 22 are.

decisions.choice: the wording of the Vietnamese Psalm 18 kept through the song
decisions.reason: The song is Psalm 18 (meaning decision); each level reuses the published Vietnamese Psalm 18 wording wherever the Hebrew is the same, and follows the English decisions where it differs. The song is set in lines as the English is.

decisions.choice: the Korean wording of the published Psalm 18 is reused at each level wherever the Hebrew is the same, and set in lines as the English record of 2 Samuel 22 is
decisions.reason: This song is Psalm 18. Keeping one Korean wording lets readers recognise it; each place where Samuel's Hebrew differs is changed to follow it, with a decision where the difference is one a reader could notice.
For the whole song (also Psalm 18): "cântico" is the Portuguese word for a song sung to God, as Exodus 15:1 and Deuteronomy 31:30 name the songs of Moses; "canção" would sound like a popular song.

The Hebrew says "the palm" (m3), and the English Literal keeps it; Portuguese "da palma de todos os seus inimigos" would not be understood, while "da mão" is the Portuguese idiom for someone's power, so Literal says "mão" both times. Balanced says "do poder", as the English does.

records.literal_gloss: And he said, YHWH [is] my rock and my stronghold and my deliverer for me,

en.L: And he said: \q "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] my crag and my stronghold and my deliverer for me,
en.B: He said: \q "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is my cliff, my stronghold, the one who sets me free,
en.R: He said: \q "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is like a high rock where I am safe. He is like a fort, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rescues me.

es.L: Y dijo: \q «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] mi peña y mi fortaleza y mi libertador para mí,
es.B: Él dijo: \q «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es mi peñasco, mi fortaleza, el que me libera,
es.R: Dijo: \q «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es como una roca alta donde estoy a salvo. Es como una fortaleza, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me rescata.

fr.L: Et il dit : \q « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] mon roc, et ma forteresse, et mon libérateur à moi,
fr.B: Il dit : \q « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est ma falaise, ma forteresse, celui qui me libère,
fr.R: Il a dit : \q « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est comme un haut rocher où je suis en sécurité. Il est comme une forteresse, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me délivre.

sw.L: Akasema: \q "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] jabali langu na ngome yangu na mwokozi wangu kwa ajili yangu,
sw.B: Alisema: \q "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni jabali langu, ngome yangu, yule anayeniweka huru,
sw.R: Alisema: \q "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni kama mwamba mrefu ambapo niko salama. Yeye ni kama ngome, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ananiokoa.

vi.L: Ông nói: \q "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] vách đá của tôi, đồn lũy của tôi, và Đấng giải cứu tôi, của riêng tôi,
vi.B: Ông nói: \q "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là vách đá của tôi, là đồn lũy của tôi, là Đấng giải thoát tôi,
vi.R: Ông nói: \q "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} như một vách đá cao, nơi tôi được an toàn. Ngài như một đồn lũy, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu tôi.

ko.L: 그가 말하였다. \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 나의 바위, 나의 요새, 나를 위해 나를 건지시는 분,
ko.B: 그가 말하였다. \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 나의 바위 절벽, 나의 요새, 나를 건지시는 분이시다.
ko.R: 그가 말하였다. \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 내가 안전하게 숨을 수 있는 높은 바위와 같으시다. 그분은 요새와 같으시고, 나를 구해 주신다.

pt.L: E disse: \q "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} [é] a minha rocha, e a minha fortaleza, e o meu libertador para mim,
pt.B: Ele disse: \q "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é a minha rocha, a minha fortaleza e o meu libertador,
pt.R: Ele disse: \q "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é como uma rocha alta onde estou seguro. Ele é como uma fortaleza, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me livra.

decisions.reason: The whole song, to verse 51, is David's speech; the quotation opens here and closes at the end of the chapter. Verses 2 and 3 are one long sentence of names for God.

decisions.choice: rock, stronghold: places of safety in the hills
decisions.reason: David hid from Saul in the rocky heights and strongholds of the wilderness (1 Samuel 23:14, 25). The words for these places (sela', metsudah, and misgav in verse 3) become names for God himself.
Psalm 18:2 has one more line after "And he said": "I love you, LORD, my strength." Psalm 18:3 has no "for me" after "my deliverer".

decisions.choice: my deliverer for me: my own deliverer
decisions.reason: The added "for me" stresses that the LORD is David's own rescuer.
Balanced and Readable carry the stress of "for me" with "my" and "me" rather than repeat it.

decisions.choice: like a high rock, like a fort
decisions.reason: Readable makes the pictures comparisons, as at Psalm 18:3, so that young readers do not take them literally.

decisions.choice: lines set as the English levels set them
decisions.reason: The English record sets this song in lines at every level (\q), and the Samuel terms note has the French follow those lines, though the French Psalm 18 is prose. The words of the psalm are kept; only the line breaks are added.

decisions.choice: a minha rocha; a minha fortaleza
decisions.reason: For the whole song: the places where David hid from Saul (m2) are "rocha" and "fortaleza", the words of 1 Samuel 23:14, 25 in Portuguese, so the names for God keep the picture of the hills. Portuguese uses "rocha" both for this word (sela', English "crag", "cliff") and for tsur in verses 3, 32 and 47, as the English cannot keep two common words apart in Portuguese without a rare one ("penhasco"). It stays lowercase, as the English does; "a Rocha" takes a capital only where the English writes it as a title (23:3), as in Deuteronomy 32.

source.text: אֱלֹהֵ֥י צוּרִ֖י אֶחֱסֶה־בּ֑וֹ מָגִנִּ֞י וְקֶ֣רֶן יִשְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּי֙ וּמְנוּסִ֔י מֹשִׁעִ֕י מֵחָמָ֖ס תֹּשִׁעֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: God of my rock, I take refuge in him, my shield and [the] horn of my salvation, my high refuge and my place of escape, my savior; from violence you save me.

en.L: the God of my rock in whom I take refuge, \q my shield and the horn of my salvation, my high refuge and my place of escape, \q my savior; from violence {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} save me.
en.B: my God, my rock, in whom I shelter, \q my shield, my strong salvation, my tower on the heights and my place of escape, \q my savior; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} save me from violence.
en.R: My God is like a rock where I can run for safety. \q He protects me like a shield. He is strong to save me. He is like a tower high above my enemies, a place where I can escape. \q He is the one who saves me. You save me from people who do violence.

es.L: el Dios de mi roca, en quien me refugio; \q mi escudo y el cuerno de mi salvación, mi alto refugio y mi lugar de escape, \q mi salvador; de la violencia {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me salvas.
es.B: mi Dios, mi roca, en quien me refugio; \q mi escudo, mi poderosa salvación, mi torre en las alturas y mi lugar de escape, \q mi salvador; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me salvas de la violencia.
es.R: Mi Dios es como una roca adonde puedo correr para estar a salvo. \q Me protege como un escudo. Él es fuerte para salvarme. Es como una torre muy por encima de mis enemigos, un lugar donde puedo escapar. \q Él es el que me salva. Tú me salvas de la gente violenta.

fr.L: le Dieu de mon rocher, en qui je me réfugie, \q mon bouclier et la corne de mon salut, mon haut refuge et mon lieu de fuite, \q mon sauveur ; de la violence {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me sauves.
fr.B: mon Dieu, mon rocher, en qui je m’abrite, \q mon bouclier, mon salut puissant, ma tour sur les hauteurs et mon lieu de refuge, \q mon sauveur ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me sauves de la violence.
fr.R: Mon Dieu est comme un rocher où je peux courir me mettre à l’abri. \q Il me protège comme un bouclier. Il est assez fort pour me sauver. Il est comme une tour, bien au-dessus de mes ennemis, un endroit où je peux m’échapper. \q C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui me sauve. Tu me sauves des gens violents.

sw.L: Mungu wa mwamba wangu ninayemkimbilia, \q ngao yangu na pembe ya wokovu wangu, kimbilio langu la juu na mahali pangu pa kukimbilia, \q mwokozi wangu; kutoka kwa jeuri {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unaniokoa.
sw.B: Mungu wangu, mwamba wangu, ninayejificha {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, \q ngao yangu, wokovu wangu wenye nguvu, mnara wangu juu milimani na mahali pangu pa kukimbilia, \q mwokozi wangu; {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unaniokoa na jeuri.
sw.R: Mungu wangu ni kama mwamba ninaoweza kuukimbilia ili niwe salama. \q Ananilinda kama ngao. Ana nguvu za kuniokoa. Yeye ni kama mnara ulio juu sana, mbali na adui zangu, mahali ninapoweza kukimbilia. \q Yeye ndiye anayeniokoa. Wewe unaniokoa na watu wenye jeuri.

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời là vầng đá của tôi, nơi tôi nương náu, \q cái khiên của tôi và sừng cứu rỗi của tôi, nơi trú ẩn trên cao và nơi tôi lánh nạn, \q Đấng cứu tôi; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứu tôi khỏi bạo lực.
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời của tôi là vầng đá, nơi tôi trú ẩn. \q Ngài là cái khiên của tôi, là Đấng cứu rỗi đầy quyền năng của tôi, là tháp cao trên núi và nơi tôi lánh nạn, \q là Đấng cứu tôi; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứu tôi khỏi bạo lực.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời của tôi như vầng đá, nơi tôi có thể chạy đến để được an toàn. \q Ngài bảo vệ tôi như cái khiên. Ngài đầy quyền năng để cứu tôi. Ngài như một ngọn tháp cao vượt khỏi tầm kẻ thù, là nơi tôi có thể thoát thân. \q Ngài là Đấng cứu tôi. Ngài cứu tôi khỏi những kẻ hung bạo.

ko.L: 내가 피하는 내 반석의 하나님, \q 나의 방패, 내 구원의 뿔, 나의 높은 피난처, 나의 도피처, \q 나의 구원자이시다. 주님께서 저를 폭력에서 구원하십니다.
ko.B: 나의 하나님은 나의 반석이시니, 나는 그분께 피한다. \q 그분은 나의 방패, 나의 강한 구원, 높은 곳에 있는 나의 망대, 나의 피난처, \q 나의 구원자이시다. 주님께서 저를 폭력에서 구원하십니다.
ko.R: 나의 하나님은 내가 피할 수 있는 반석과 같으시다. \q 그분은 방패처럼 나를 지키신다. 그분은 나를 구원하실 힘이 있으시다. 그분은 내 원수들보다 높이 솟은 망대와 같으시고, 내가 피할 수 있는 곳이시다. \q 그분은 나를 구원하시는 분이시다. 주님께서 저를 폭력을 휘두르는 사람들에게서 구원하십니다.

pt.L: o Deus da minha rocha, em quem me refugio, \q o meu escudo e o chifre da minha salvação, o meu alto refúgio e o meu lugar de fuga, \q o meu salvador; da violência {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me salvas.
pt.B: o meu Deus, a minha rocha, em quem me abrigo, \q o meu escudo, a minha salvação poderosa, a minha torre nas alturas e o meu lugar de fuga, \q o meu salvador; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me salvas da violência.
pt.R: O meu Deus é como uma rocha para onde posso correr e ficar seguro. \q Ele me protege como um escudo. Ele é forte para me salvar. Ele é como uma torre bem acima dos meus inimigos, um lugar para onde posso fugir. \q Ele é quem me salva. Tu me livras das pessoas violentas.

decisions.choice: the God of my rock: my God, who is my rock
decisions.reason: The phrase joins God and rock: the God who is David's rock. The song ends with the same kind of phrase, "the God of the rock of my salvation" (verse 47).

decisions.choice: the horn of my salvation: my strong savior
decisions.reason: A horn is the strength of an animal and so a picture of power (Psalm 75:11; 1 Samuel 2:1); "the horn of my salvation" is the power that saves me.

decisions.choice: you save me: the song speaks to God
decisions.reason: After the list of names the song turns for a moment from speaking of God to speaking to him, as it does again in verses 29 and 49.

Psalm 18:3 has "my God, my rock" where this verse has "the God of my rock", and it ends at "my high refuge". The last words here, "and my place of escape, my savior; from violence you save me", are not in the psalm.

decisions.choice: my strong salvation (B); He is strong to save me (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the horn means (m2), as at Psalm 18:3.
Balanced gives the sense of "the God of my rock" (m1) in the words of Psalm 18:3.

decisions.choice: like a rock, like a shield, like a tower
decisions.reason: As in verse 2, Readable makes the pictures comparisons.
The song turns briefly from speaking of God to speaking to him (meaning decision); Vietnamese "Ngài" serves for both, as in the Vietnamese Psalms, so the turn needs no new pronoun.

decisions.choice: the last clause turns to God in the formal style with "주님" and "저" ("주님께서 저를 ... 구원하십니다"), while the rest of the verse speaks about God in the plain style with "나"
decisions.reason: Samuel's text adds "you save me from violence", spoken to God. The terms of this translation follow the Hebrew's turns between speaking to God and about God, as in the published Psalm 18.

Literal keeps the animal's horn, as Hannah's song does at Literal in 1 Samuel 2:1 and 2:10, so the picture of strength (m2) can be seen; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does ("a minha salvação poderosa", "forte para me salvar").

When the song turns to speak to God (m3; also verses 26-30, 36-41, 44, 49-50), David says "tu", the form of prayer throughout the Portuguese Old Testament, with deity_pronoun spans where the pronoun stands inside the sentence; a pronoun that opens a sentence is written plainly with its capital.

source.text: מְהֻלָּ֖ל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּמֵאֹיְבַ֖י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The one who is] to be praised I call [on], YHWH, and from my enemies I am saved.

en.L: [The one who is] worthy of praise I call [on], {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and from my enemies I am saved.
en.B: I call on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who is worthy of praise, \q and from my enemies I am rescued.
en.R: I call to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who deserves all praise, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saves me from my enemies.

es.L: [Al que es] digno de alabanza invoco, {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, \q y de mis enemigos soy salvado.
es.B: Invoco {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, que es digno de alabanza, \q y soy rescatado de mis enemigos.
es.R: Clamo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, que merece toda alabanza, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me salva de mis enemigos.

fr.L: [Celui qui est] digne de louange, je [l’]invoque, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q et de mes ennemis je suis sauvé.
fr.B: J’invoque {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui est digne de louange, \q et je suis délivré de mes ennemis.
fr.R: J’appelle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui mérite toutes les louanges, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me sauve de mes ennemis.

sw.L: [Yeye astahiliye] kusifiwa ninamwita, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q nami ninaokolewa kutoka kwa adui zangu.
sw.B: Ninamwita {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, anayestahili kusifiwa, \q nami ninaokolewa kutoka kwa adui zangu.
sw.R: Ninamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, anayestahili sifa zote, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ananiokoa kutoka kwa adui zangu.

vi.L: Tôi kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, [Đấng] đáng được ca ngợi, \q và tôi được cứu khỏi các kẻ thù của tôi.
vi.B: Tôi kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng đáng được ca ngợi, \q và tôi được giải cứu khỏi các kẻ thù.
vi.R: Tôi kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng đáng được mọi lời ca ngợi, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứu tôi khỏi kẻ thù.

ko.L: 찬양받으실 분 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 내가 부르니, \q 내 원수들에게서 내가 구원받는다.
ko.B: 찬양받기에 합당하신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 내가 부르면, \q 내 원수들에게서 건짐을 받는다.
ko.R: 모든 찬양을 받으셔야 할 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 내가 부르짖으면, \q 그분께서 내 원수들에게서 나를 구원하신다.

pt.L: [Aquele que é] digno de louvor eu invoco, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q e dos meus inimigos sou salvo.
pt.B: Invoco {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que é digno de louvor, \q e sou resgatado dos meus inimigos.
pt.R: Eu clamo {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, que merece todo o louvor, \q e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me salva dos meus inimigos.

decisions.choice: I call, I am saved: what always happens
decisions.reason: The verbs are in the unfinished form: whenever David calls, he is saved. Verses 5-20 then tell one great rescue.

decisions.choice: the one to be praised: worthy of praise
decisions.reason: The word (mehullal) means praised, deserving praise (Psalm 48:2; 96:4).
Psalm 18:4 has the same words, with a longer spelling of "from".

source.text: כִּ֥י אֲפָפֻ֖נִי מִשְׁבְּרֵי־מָ֑וֶת נַחֲלֵ֥י בְלִיַּ֖עַל יְבַעֲתֻֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: For encompassed me [the] breakers of death; torrents of worthlessness terrified me.

en.L: For the breakers of death encompassed me; \q torrents of destruction terrified me.
en.B: For the waves of death swirled around me; \q floods of ruin overwhelmed me with terror.
en.R: Death was like waves crashing all around me. \q Danger poured over me like a flood, and I was terrified.

es.L: Porque me rodearon las olas de la muerte; \q torrentes de destrucción me aterrorizaron.
es.B: Porque las olas de la muerte se arremolinaron a mi alrededor; \q ríos de ruina me llenaron de terror.
es.R: La muerte era como olas que rompían a mi alrededor. \q El peligro me cubrió como una inundación, y yo estaba aterrado.

fr.L: Car les vagues de la mort m’ont enveloppé ; \q les torrents de la destruction m’ont épouvanté.
fr.B: Car les flots de la mort tourbillonnaient autour de moi ; \q des flots de ruine m’avaient rempli de terreur.
fr.R: La mort était comme des vagues qui se brisaient tout autour de moi. \q Le danger déferlait sur moi comme une inondation, et j’étais terrifié.

sw.L: Kwa maana mawimbi ya mauti yalinizunguka; \q mafuriko ya maangamizi yalinitia hofu.
sw.B: Kwa maana mawimbi ya kifo yalinizunguka pande zote; \q mafuriko ya uharibifu yalinilemea kwa hofu.
sw.R: Kifo kilikuwa kama mawimbi yaliyonipiga pande zote. \q Hatari ilinimwagikia kama mafuriko, nami nikaogopa sana.

vi.L: Vì những ngọn sóng của sự chết vây lấy tôi; \q những dòng thác hủy diệt làm tôi kinh hãi.
vi.B: Vì những đợt sóng của sự chết cuộn quanh tôi; \q những cơn lũ hủy diệt tràn ngập tôi trong nỗi kinh hoàng.
vi.R: Sự chết như những đợt sóng đập vào tôi tứ phía. \q Hiểm nguy tràn qua tôi như cơn lũ, và tôi kinh hãi.

ko.L: 참으로 죽음의 파도가 나를 에워쌌고, \q 파멸의 급류가 나를 두렵게 하였다.
ko.B: 죽음의 파도가 내 주위에 소용돌이쳤고, \q 멸망의 물결이 나를 덮쳐 두려움에 떨게 하였다.
ko.R: 죽음이 파도처럼 내 주위에 몰아쳤다. \q 위험이 홍수처럼 나를 덮쳐서 나는 몹시 두려웠다.

pt.L: Pois me cercaram as ondas da morte; \q torrentes de destruição me aterrorizaram.
pt.B: Pois as ondas da morte se agitaram ao meu redor; \q torrentes de ruína me encheram de terror.
pt.R: A morte era como ondas quebrando à minha volta. \q O perigo caía sobre mim como uma enchente, e eu fiquei apavorado.

decisions.choice: breakers: waves that break over a person
decisions.reason: The word (mishbar) is a breaking wave (Psalm 42:8; Jonah 2:4). With the torrents of the next line, death is pictured as a flood.
The word (beliyya'al) means what is worthless and destructive; it later became a name for evil and for Satan (2 Corinthians 6:15).
The verse begins to explain the danger from which he called to the LORD (verse 4).

Psalm 18:5 has "the cords of death" (chevel), matching verse 6, where this verse has "the breakers of death", matching the flood of the next line. The psalm has no "for" at the start, and joins the lines with "and".
Readable lets the link to verse 4 be understood, to keep the sentence short.

decisions.choice: "les vagues de la mort" (L, R); "les flots de la mort" (B)
alternatives: "les liens de la mort", as Psalm 18:5
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew has "breakers" where the psalm has "cords" (m1, m4), so French follows the English and changes the image.
Here the Hebrew has 'breakers' where Psalm 18:5 has 'cords', so Spanish says 'olas', as the English 'breakers' and 'waves', and keeps the rest of the Psalm's wording.

decisions.choice: mawimbi ya mauti (L); mawimbi ya kifo (B)
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew has "breakers of death" where Psalm 18:5 has "cords of death"; Swahili follows the difference with "mawimbi" (waves), as the English does, and keeps the Psalm's wording for the rest of the verse.

decisions.choice: "những ngọn sóng của sự chết" for the breakers of death
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew has "breakers" where Psalm 18:5 has "cords" (meaning decision), so the Vietnamese changes the picture from Psalm 18 to waves.

decisions.choice: "죽음의 파도" for "the breakers of death", and "참으로" for "for" (L)
decisions.reason: Samuel's Hebrew has "breakers" (waves), where Psalm 18:5 has "cords"; the Korean follows Samuel here and keeps the Psalm's wording in the second line.

source.text: חֶבְלֵ֥י שְׁא֖וֹל סַבֻּ֑נִי קִדְּמֻ֖נִי מֹֽקְשֵׁי־מָֽוֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] cords of Sheol surrounded me; confronted me [the] snares of death.

en.L: The cords of Sheol surrounded me; \q the snares of death confronted me.
en.B: The ropes of Sheol coiled around me; \q death's traps lay right in front of me.
en.R: It was as if the place of the dead had me tied up. \q Death had set traps for me, and I could not get away.

es.L: Las cuerdas del Seol me rodearon; \q los lazos de la muerte me salieron al encuentro.
es.B: Las sogas del lugar de los muertos se enroscaron a mi alrededor; \q las trampas de la muerte estaban justo delante de mí.
es.R: Era como si el lugar de los muertos me tuviera atado. \q La muerte me había puesto trampas, y yo no podía escapar.

fr.L: Les liens du Shéol m’ont entouré ; \q les pièges de la mort se sont dressés devant moi.
fr.B: Les cordes du séjour des morts s’enroulaient autour de moi ; \q les pièges de la mort étaient juste devant moi.
fr.R: C’était comme si le séjour des morts m’avait ligoté. \q La mort m’avait tendu des pièges, et je ne pouvais pas m’échapper.

sw.L: Kamba za Kuzimu zilinizunguka; \q mitego ya mauti ilinikabili.
sw.B: Kamba za Kuzimu zilinizingira; \q mitego ya kifo ilikuwa mbele yangu kabisa.
sw.R: Ilikuwa kana kwamba Kuzimu ilinifunga kwa kamba. \q Kifo kilikuwa kimeniwekea mitego, nami sikuweza kutoroka.

vi.L: Những dây thừng của Âm Phủ vây quanh tôi; \q những cạm bẫy của sự chết đối diện tôi.
vi.B: Dây thừng của Âm Phủ cuộn quanh tôi; \q cạm bẫy của sự chết giăng ngay trước mặt tôi.
vi.R: Như thể nơi của người chết đã trói chặt tôi. \q Sự chết đã giăng bẫy tôi, và tôi không thể thoát ra.

ko.L: 스올의 줄들이 나를 둘렀고, \q 죽음의 올무들이 내 앞에 닥쳤다.
ko.B: 스올의 밧줄이 나를 감았고, \q 죽음의 덫이 바로 내 앞에 놓였다.
ko.R: 죽은 사람들이 있는 곳이 나를 꽁꽁 묶어 놓은 것 같았다. \q 죽음이 내 앞에 덫을 놓아서 나는 빠져나갈 수 없었다.

pt.L: As cordas do Sheol me cercaram; \q os laços da morte me confrontaram.
pt.B: As cordas do mundo dos mortos se enrolaram em mim; \q as armadilhas da morte estavam bem diante de mim.
pt.R: Era como se o mundo dos mortos me tivesse amarrado. \q A morte tinha armado armadilhas para mim, e eu não conseguia escapar.

decisions.choice: Sheol: the place of the dead
decisions.reason: Sheol is the place of the dead, pictured under the earth (1 Samuel 2:6). Here it is a hunter that has David bound.

decisions.choice: the snares of death confronted me: death stood in my way
decisions.reason: Death is a hunter whose traps meet the singer at every turn (Psalm 116:3).
Psalm 18:6 has the same words, with small differences of spelling.
Readable explains the name, as at Psalm 18:6.

decisions.choice: o Sheol (L); o mundo dos mortos (B, R)
decisions.reason: As docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md sets it for the Old Testament and 1 Samuel 2:6 has it: the name at Literal, and "o mundo dos mortos" at Balanced and Readable (m1), where the English keeps "Sheol" at Balanced. "Inferno" would bring in the later idea of punishment.

source.text: בַּצַּר־לִי֙ אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֔ה וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַ֖י אֶקְרָ֑א וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע מֵהֵֽיכָלוֹ֙ קוֹלִ֔י וְשַׁוְעָתִ֖י בְּאָזְנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: In my distress I called [on] YHWH, and to my God I called; and he heard from his temple my voice, and my cry for help [was] in his ears.

en.L: In my distress I called [on] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and to my God I called; \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} heard my voice from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple, and my cry [came] into {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ears.
en.B: When I was hard pressed I called on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; I called to my God. \q Out of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} listened to my voice; my cry reached {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ears.
en.R: When I was in trouble, I called out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I called to my God. \q He was in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} heard me. My cry reached {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ears.

es.L: En mi angustia invoqué {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y a mi Dios clamé; \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} oyó mi voz desde {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo, y mi clamor [llegó] a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} oídos.
es.B: Cuando estaba en aprietos, invoqué {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; clamé a mi Dios. \q Desde {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} escuchó mi voz; mi clamor alcanzó {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} oídos.
es.R: Cuando estaba en problemas, clamé {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Clamé a mi Dios. \q Él estaba en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me oyó. Mi clamor llegó a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} oídos.

fr.L: Dans ma détresse j’ai invoqué {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et vers mon Dieu j’ai crié ; \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a entendu ma voix de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple, et mon cri [est parvenu] à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} oreilles.
fr.B: Quand j’étais acculé, j’ai invoqué {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; j’ai crié vers mon Dieu. \q De {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a écouté ma voix ; mon cri a atteint {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} oreilles.
fr.R: Quand j’étais dans le malheur, j’ai appelé {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. J’ai crié vers mon Dieu. \q Il était dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a entendu. Mon cri est arrivé jusqu’à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} oreilles.

sw.L: Katika dhiki yangu nilimwita {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na kwa Mungu wangu niliita; \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akasikia sauti yangu kutoka hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, na kilio changu [kikaingia] masikioni {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}.
sw.B: Nilipobanwa sana nilimwita {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; nilimwita Mungu wangu. \q Kutoka hekaluni {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}} aliisikiliza sauti yangu; kilio changu kilifika masikioni {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}.
sw.R: Nilipokuwa taabuni, nilimlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nilimwita Mungu wangu. \q Alikuwa katika hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akanisikia. Kilio changu kilifika masikioni {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}.

vi.L: Trong cơn quẫn bách tôi đã kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và tôi đã kêu cầu Đức Chúa Trời của tôi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nghe tiếng tôi từ đền thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và tiếng kêu cứu của tôi đã thấu đến tai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Khi bị dồn ép, tôi đã kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; tôi đã kêu cầu Đức Chúa Trời của tôi. \q Từ đền thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lắng nghe tiếng tôi; tiếng kêu của tôi đã thấu đến tai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Khi gặp hoạn nạn, tôi đã kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Tôi đã kêu cầu Đức Chúa Trời của tôi. \q Ngài ở trong đền thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nghe tôi. Tiếng kêu của tôi đã thấu đến tai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 내 고난 중에 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 부르고, 나의 하나님께 불렀더니, \q 그분께서 그분의 성전에서 내 목소리를 들으셨고, 내 부르짖음이 그분의 귀에 [들어갔다].
ko.B: 내가 궁지에 몰렸을 때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 부르고 나의 하나님께 부르짖었다. \q 그분께서 그분의 성전에서 내 목소리를 들으셨고, 내 부르짖음이 그분의 귀에 닿았다.
ko.R: 내가 어려움을 당할 때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖었다. 나의 하나님께 부르짖었다. \q 그분은 그분의 성전에 계셨고, 내 말을 들으셨다. 내 부르짖음이 그분의 귀에 닿았다.

pt.L: Na minha angústia clamei {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, e ao meu Deus clamei; \q e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ouviu a minha voz desde o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} templo, e o meu grito por socorro [chegou] aos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} ouvidos.
pt.B: Quando eu estava em aperto, clamei {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}; clamei ao meu Deus. \q Do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} templo {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ouviu a minha voz; o meu grito chegou aos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} ouvidos.
pt.R: Quando eu estava em perigo, chamei {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Chamei o meu Deus. \q Ele estava no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} templo e me ouviu. O meu grito chegou aos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} ouvidos.

decisions.choice: his temple: God's dwelling in heaven
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 11:4, the temple is God's palace in heaven, from which he comes down in verses 8-17.

decisions.choice: I called, he heard: the story of the rescue
decisions.reason: Here the song turns to tell the rescue as a past event.
Psalm 18:7 has "I cried for help" (shava') in place of the second "I called", "he heard" without "and", and "my cry before him came into his ears" where this verse has "my cry into his ears".

decisions.choice: the story of the rescue (verses 7-20) in the passé composé at every level
alternatives: passé simple at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: David is speaking, so French keeps the tenses of speech, as the published Psalm 18 does; the narrative passé simple of this block is for the narrator only.

source.text: וַיִּתְגָּעַ֤שׁוַתִּרְעַשׁ֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ מוֹסְד֥וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַיִּֽתְגָּעֲשׁ֖וּ כִּֽי־חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And shook and quaked the earth; [the] foundations of the heavens trembled and shook, for it burned to him.

en.L: And the earth shook and quaked; \q the foundations of the heavens trembled and shook, \q for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was angry.
en.B: Then the earth shuddered and rocked; \q the foundations of the heavens trembled and were shaken, \q because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was furious.
en.R: Then the earth shook. \q Even the pillars that hold up the sky shook, \q because God was very angry.

es.L: Y la tierra se sacudió y tembló; \q los cimientos de los cielos se estremecieron y se sacudieron, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estaba enojado.
es.B: Entonces la tierra se estremeció y se tambaleó; \q los cimientos de los cielos temblaron y se sacudieron, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estaba furioso.
es.R: Entonces la tierra tembló. \q Hasta las columnas que sostienen el cielo temblaron, \q porque Dios estaba muy enojado.

fr.L: Et la terre a tremblé et vacillé ; \q les fondements des cieux ont frémi et ont été ébranlés, \q car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était en colère.
fr.B: Alors la terre a frissonné et chancelé ; \q les fondations des cieux ont tremblé, ébranlées, \q parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était furieux.
fr.R: Alors la terre a tremblé. \q Même les colonnes qui soutiennent le ciel ont tremblé, \q parce que Dieu était très en colère.

sw.L: Ndipo nchi ikatikisika na kutetemeka; \q misingi ya mbingu ikatetemeka na kutikiswa, \q kwa maana alikuwa amekasirika.
sw.B: Kisha dunia ikatetemeka na kuyumba; \q misingi ya mbingu ikatetemeka na kutikiswa, \q kwa sababu alikuwa amekasirika sana.
sw.R: Kisha dunia ikatikisika. \q Hata nguzo zinazotegemeza anga zikatikisika, \q kwa sababu Mungu alikuwa amekasirika sana.

vi.L: Đất rúng động và chuyển rung; \q các nền của các tầng trời run rẩy và lay động, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nổi giận.
vi.B: Bấy giờ đất rung chuyển và lắc lư; \q nền móng các tầng trời run rẩy và bị lay động, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nổi cơn thịnh nộ.
vi.R: Bấy giờ đất rung chuyển. \q Ngay cả những cột chống đỡ bầu trời cũng rung lắc, \q vì Đức Chúa Trời rất giận.

ko.L: 그러자 땅이 흔들리고 진동하였으며, \q 하늘의 기초가 떨리고 흔들렸으니, \q 그분께서 노하셨기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그때 땅이 흔들리고 요동쳤으며, \q 하늘의 기초가 떨리고 뒤흔들렸다. \q 그분께서 진노하셨기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그러자 땅이 흔들렸다. \q 하늘을 받치고 있는 기둥들까지 흔들렸다. \q 하나님께서 몹시 노하셨기 때문이다.

pt.L: E a terra tremeu e se abalou; \q os fundamentos dos céus estremeceram e se sacudiram, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se irou.
pt.B: Então a terra estremeceu e balançou; \q os fundamentos dos céus tremeram e foram sacudidos, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} estava furioso.
pt.R: Então a terra tremeu. \q Até as colunas que sustentam o céu tremeram, \q porque Deus estava muito irado.

decisions.choice: the earth shook: the LORD comes as at Sinai
decisions.reason: Verses 8-16 picture the LORD coming down in storm and earthquake, as he did at Mount Sinai (Exodus 19:16-18) and when he led Israel out of Egypt (Judges 5:4-5; Psalm 68:8-9).

decisions.choice: the foundations of the heavens: the mountains that hold up the sky
decisions.reason: The sky was pictured as resting on pillars at the ends of the earth (Job 26:11). The whole world, from the sky down to its base, shakes when God comes.

decisions.choice: it burned to him: he was angry
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "it burned to him", a common way of saying that anger flared up (Genesis 4:5).

Psalm 18:8 has "the foundations of the mountains" where this verse has "the foundations of the heavens". The first verb is written here as in the psalm but marked to be read in another form of the same verb, with the same sense.

decisions.choice: God; the pillars that hold up the sky
decisions.reason: Readable names who was angry, and says what the foundations of the heavens are (m2).

decisions.choice: los cimientos de los cielos (L, B); las columnas que sostienen el cielo (R)
decisions.reason: Where Psalm 18:8 has the foundations of the mountains, 2 Samuel has the foundations of the heavens; the Spanish follows the English here and the Psalm elsewhere in the verse.
Samuel's Hebrew reads "the foundations of the heavens", where the Psalm has "of the mountains"; Readable explains them as the pillars that hold up the sky, as the English Readable does.

source.text: עָלָ֤ה עָשָׁן֙ בְּאַפּ֔וֹ וְאֵ֥שׁ מִפִּ֖יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּחָלִ֖ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Went up smoke in his nose, and fire from his mouth devoured; coals burned from it.

en.L: Smoke went up from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} nostrils, \q and fire from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mouth devoured; \q coals blazed from it.
en.B: Smoke rose from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} nostrils, \q and fire that consumes came from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mouth; \q burning coals flamed out of it.
en.R: Smoke came out of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} nose. \q Fire that burns up everything came out of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mouth, with red-hot coals.

es.L: Subió humo de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nariz, \q y fuego de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} boca devoraba; \q brasas ardían de él.
es.B: Salió humo de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nariz, \q y de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} boca un fuego que consume; \q carbones encendidos salían de ella.
es.R: Salió humo de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nariz. \q De {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} boca salió un fuego que lo quema todo, con brasas al rojo vivo.

fr.L: Une fumée est montée de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} narines, \q et un feu de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} bouche dévorait ; \q des braises en jaillissaient enflammées.
fr.B: La fumée s’élevait de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} narines, \q et un feu dévorant sortait de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} bouche ; \q des charbons ardents en jaillissaient.
fr.R: De la fumée est sortie de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nez. \q Un feu qui brûle tout est sorti de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} bouche, avec des braises rouges.

sw.L: Moshi ulipanda kutoka puani {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}, \q na moto kutoka kinywani {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}} ukala; \q makaa yaliwaka kutokana nao.
sw.B: Moshi ulipanda kutoka puani {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}, \q na moto unaoteketeza ukatoka kinywani {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}; \q makaa yanayowaka yakatoka ndani yake.
sw.R: Moshi ulitoka puani {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}. \q Moto unaoteketeza kila kitu ukatoka kinywani {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}, pamoja na makaa ya moto mekundu.

vi.L: Khói bốc lên từ lỗ mũi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và lửa từ miệng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thiêu nuốt; \q than hồng bừng cháy từ đó.
vi.B: Khói bốc lên từ lỗ mũi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và lửa thiêu đốt phát ra từ miệng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q than hồng rực cháy từ đó tuôn ra.
vi.R: Khói phun ra từ mũi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Lửa thiêu đốt mọi thứ phun ra từ miệng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, cùng với than đỏ rực.

ko.L: 그분의 콧구멍에서 연기가 올라가고, \q 그분의 입에서 불이 나와 삼켰으며, \q 그것에서 숯불이 타올랐다.
ko.B: 그분의 콧구멍에서 연기가 솟아오르고, \q 그분의 입에서 모든 것을 삼키는 불이 나왔으며, \q 거기서 숯불이 이글거렸다.
ko.R: 그분의 코에서 연기가 나왔다. \q 그분의 입에서는 모든 것을 태워 버리는 불이 시뻘건 숯불과 함께 나왔다.

pt.L: Subiu fumaça das {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} narinas, \q e fogo da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} boca devorava; \q brasas ardiam dele.
pt.B: Fumaça subiu das {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} narinas, \q e da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} boca saiu um fogo que consome; \q brasas em chamas saltavam do fogo.
pt.R: Saiu fumaça do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nariz. \q Da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} boca saiu um fogo que queima tudo, com brasas vermelhas de tão quentes.

decisions.choice: smoke in his nose: a picture of anger
decisions.reason: In Hebrew the nose is the seat of anger (the word 'af means both); the snorting of fury is pictured as smoke and fire.

decisions.choice: fire from his mouth: God's holy anger
decisions.reason: The LORD is a consuming fire (Deuteronomy 4:24). The picture is poetry for God's power against those who oppose him.
Psalm 18:9 has the same words.

source.text: וַיֵּ֥ט שָׁמַ֖יִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַעֲרָפֶ֖ל תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he bent [the] heavens and came down, and thick darkness [was] under his feet.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} bent the heavens and came down, \q and thick darkness [was] under {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet.
en.B: He bowed the heavens low and came down; \q storm clouds were dark beneath {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet.
en.R: He opened the sky and came down. \q Dark clouds were under {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} inclinó los cielos y descendió, \q y oscuridad densa [había] debajo de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies.
es.B: Bajó los cielos y descendió; \q bajo {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies había oscuras nubes de tormenta.
es.R: Abrió el cielo y bajó. \q Había nubes oscuras debajo de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a incliné les cieux et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est descendu, \q et une épaisse obscurité [était] sous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds.
fr.B: Il a abaissé les cieux et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est descendu ; \q des nuées d’orage sombres étaient sous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds.
fr.R: Il a ouvert le ciel et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est descendu. \q Des nuages noirs étaient sous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds.

sw.L: Akaziinamisha mbingu akashuka, \q na giza nene [lilikuwa] chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Aliziinamisha mbingu chini akashuka; \q mawingu meusi ya dhoruba yalikuwa chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Alifungua anga akashuka. \q Mawingu meusi yalikuwa chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghiêng các tầng trời và ngự xuống, \q và bóng tối dày đặc [ở] dưới chân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Ngài hạ thấp các tầng trời và ngự xuống; \q mây giông đen kịt dưới chân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ngài mở bầu trời và ngự xuống. \q Mây đen ở dưới chân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그분께서 하늘을 굽히시고 내려오셨으니, \q 짙은 어둠이 그분의 발아래 [있었다].
ko.B: 그분께서 하늘을 낮게 드리우시고 내려오셨다. \q 그분의 발아래에는 먹구름이 짙게 깔렸다.
ko.R: 그분께서 하늘을 여시고 내려오셨다. \q 그분의 발아래에는 검은 구름이 있었다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} inclinou os céus e desceu, \q e densa escuridão [estava] debaixo dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} pés.
pt.B: Ele abaixou os céus e desceu; \q nuvens escuras de tempestade estavam debaixo dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} pés.
pt.R: Ele abriu o céu e desceu. \q Nuvens escuras estavam debaixo dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} pés.

decisions.choice: bent the heavens: bowed the sky down
decisions.reason: The verb (natah) means to stretch out or bend; the sky bows down as God comes (Psalm 144:5).

decisions.choice: thick darkness: the dark cloud around God
decisions.reason: The thick darkness ('arafel) is the cloud in which God came to Sinai (Exodus 20:21; Deuteronomy 4:11).
Psalm 18:10 has the same words.

source.text: וַיִּרְכַּ֥ב עַל־כְּר֖וּב וַיָּעֹ֑ף וַיֵּרָ֖א עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רֽוּחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he rode on a cherub and flew, and he was seen on [the] wings of [the] wind.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rode on a cherub and flew, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was seen on the wings of the wind.
en.B: Riding on a cherub, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} flew; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared on the wings of the wind.
en.R: He flew, riding on a cherub. \q He was seen, carried by the wind.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} cabalgó sobre un querubín y voló, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} fue visto sobre las alas del viento.
es.B: Montado sobre un querubín, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} voló; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} apareció sobre las alas del viento.
es.R: Voló, montado en un querubín. \q Se le vio llevado por el viento.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est monté sur un chérubin et a volé, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est apparu sur les ailes du vent.
fr.B: Monté sur un chérubin, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a pris {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} vol ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est apparu sur les ailes du vent.
fr.R: Il a volé, monté sur un chérubin. \q On {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a vu, porté par le vent.

sw.L: Akapanda juu ya kerubi akaruka, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akaonekana juu ya mabawa ya upepo.
sw.B: Akiwa amepanda kerubi, aliruka; \q alionekana juu ya mabawa ya upepo.
sw.R: Aliruka akiwa amepanda kerubi. \q Alionekana akibebwa na upepo.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cưỡi trên một chê-ru-bim và bay, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hiện ra trên cánh gió.
vi.B: Cưỡi trên một chê-ru-bim, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bay đi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hiện ra trên cánh gió.
vi.R: Ngài bay đi, cưỡi trên một chê-ru-bim. \q Người ta thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, gió đưa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi.

ko.L: 그분께서 그룹을 타고 날아가시며, \q 바람의 날개 위에 나타나셨다.
ko.B: 그분께서 그룹을 타고 날아오셨다. \q 바람의 날개 위에 나타나셨다.
ko.R: 그분께서 그룹을 타고 날아오셨다. \q 바람에 실려 오시는 모습이 보였다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} montou sobre um querubim e voou, \q e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} foi visto sobre as asas do vento.
pt.B: Montado num querubim, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} voou; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} apareceu sobre as asas do vento.
pt.R: Ele voou, montado num querubim. \q Ele foi visto, levado pelo vento.

decisions.choice: a cherub: a winged being who serves God
decisions.reason: Cherubim guard God's presence (Genesis 3:24) and carry his throne (Ezekiel 10); the LORD is "enthroned on the cherubim" (1 Samuel 4:4; 2 Samuel 6:2). Here a cherub is his chariot.

decisions.choice: he was seen: God's coming made visible
decisions.reason: The God who comes hidden in cloud (verses 10, 12) is still seen in the storm as it rushes on the wind.
Psalm 18:11 has "and he swooped" (da'ah) where this verse has "and he was seen" (ra'ah). In Hebrew writing the two words differ by one letter, d for r, and the two letters look much alike.
Here the Hebrew reads "he was seen" where Psalm 18:11 has "he swooped" (meaning decision), so the Vietnamese departs from the Psalm wording.
Samuel's Hebrew reads "he was seen", one letter different from the Psalm's "he swooped"; the Korean follows Samuel.

source.text: וַיָּ֥שֶׁת חֹ֛שֶׁךְ סְבִיבֹתָ֖יו סֻכּ֑וֹת חַֽשְׁרַת־מַ֖יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he set darkness around him [as] shelters, a mass of waters, clouds of skies.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} set darkness around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} [as] shelters, \q a mass of waters, clouds of the skies.
en.B: He made darkness a tent all around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q a mass of rain clouds, thick clouds of the sky.
en.R: He put darkness all around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} like a tent. \q He was covered with heavy rain clouds.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} puso oscuridad a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} alrededor [por] pabellones, \q masa de aguas, nubes de los cielos.
es.B: Hizo de la oscuridad una tienda a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} alrededor, \q una masa de nubes de lluvia, densas nubes del cielo.
es.R: Puso oscuridad a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} alrededor como una tienda. \q Estaba cubierto de nubes pesadas de lluvia.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a mis l’obscurité autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} [comme] des abris, \q une masse d’eaux, des nuées des cieux.
fr.B: Il a fait de l’obscurité une tente tout autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \q une masse de nuages de pluie, d’épaisses nuées du ciel.
fr.R: Il a mis l’obscurité tout autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} comme une tente. \q Il était couvert de lourds nuages de pluie.

sw.L: Akaweka giza kumzunguka [kama] vibanda, \q wingi wa maji, mawingu ya anga.
sw.B: Alilifanya giza kuwa hema pande zote {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, \q mawingu mengi ya mvua, mawingu mazito ya anga.
sw.R: Aliweka giza kumzunguka kama hema. \q Alifunikwa na mawingu mazito ya mvua.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đặt bóng tối quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [làm] những chòi che, \q khối nước, mây dày của các tầng trời.
vi.B: Ngài lấy bóng tối làm lều bao quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q là khối mây mưa, mây dày đặc của bầu trời.
vi.R: Ngài đặt bóng tối quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như một cái lều. \q Mây mưa nặng trĩu bao phủ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그분께서 어둠을 그분 주위에 장막으로 두르셨으니, \q 모인 물, 하늘의 구름들이었다.
ko.B: 그분께서 어둠을 장막처럼 그분 둘레에 치셨다. \q 비를 머금은 검은 구름, 하늘의 짙은 구름이었다.
ko.R: 그분께서 어둠을 장막처럼 그분 둘레에 두르셨다. \q 비를 머금은 검은 구름이 그분을 덮었다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} pôs trevas ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} redor [como] abrigos, \q uma massa de águas, nuvens dos céus.
pt.B: Ele fez da escuridão uma tenda ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} redor, \q uma massa de nuvens de chuva, nuvens densas do céu.
pt.R: Ele pôs a escuridão ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} redor como uma tenda. \q Ele estava coberto de pesadas nuvens de chuva.

decisions.reason: The word (sukkah) is a shelter or booth; the storm clouds are God's tent (Job 36:29).

decisions.choice: a mass of waters: heavy rain clouds
decisions.reason: The word (chasherah) is found only here. A related word names the hubs of a wheel, where the spokes come together (1 Kings 7:33), so it probably means a gathering of water: clouds heavy with rain.

Psalm 18:12 has "his hiding place" and "his canopy" where this verse has "shelters", and "darkness of waters" (cheshkat) where this verse has "a mass of waters" (chasherat), a word that differs by one letter. The psalm has no "and" at the start.
The plural "shelters" is one covering all around God; Balanced and Readable say "a tent".

source.text: מִנֹּ֖גַהּ נֶגְדּ֑וֹ בָּעֲר֖וּ גַּחֲלֵי־אֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: From [the] brightness before him burned coals of fire.

en.L: From the brightness before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} \q coals of fire blazed.
en.B: Out of the brightness in front of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} \q burning coals flamed up.
en.R: From the bright light around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} \q burning coals blazed out.

es.L: Por el resplandor delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} \q ardían carbones de fuego.
es.B: Del resplandor que había delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} \q salieron llamaradas de brasas ardientes.
es.R: De la luz brillante que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} rodeaba \q salían brasas ardientes.

fr.L: De l’éclat devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} \q des braises de feu se sont embrasées.
fr.B: De l’éclat qui était devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} \q des charbons ardents ont jailli en flammes.
fr.R: De la lumière éclatante autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} \q des braises brûlantes ont jailli.

sw.L: Kutoka katika mwangaza ulio mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} \q makaa ya moto yaliwaka.
sw.B: Kutoka katika mwangaza ulio mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} \q makaa yanayowaka yalilipuka.
sw.R: Kutoka katika nuru angavu iliyomzunguka \q makaa yanayowaka yalitoka kwa nguvu.

vi.L: Từ sự rực rỡ trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q than lửa bừng cháy.
vi.B: Từ ánh sáng chói lòa trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q than hồng bùng cháy.
vi.R: Từ ánh sáng rực rỡ quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q than lửa bùng ra.

ko.L: 그분 앞의 광채로부터 \q 불타는 숯불이 타올랐다.
ko.B: 그분 앞에서 빛나는 광채 속에서 \q 숯불이 활활 타올랐다.
ko.R: 그분 둘레의 밝은 빛 속에서 \q 시뻘건 숯불이 타올랐다.

pt.L: Do resplendor diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} \q ardiam brasas de fogo.
pt.B: Do brilho que havia diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} \q brasas acesas se inflamaram.
pt.R: Da luz forte ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} redor \q saíam brasas ardentes.

decisions.reason: The brightness (nogah) is the blazing light of God's presence (Ezekiel 1:4, 28).
The burning coals that flash out of the storm are lightning (Psalm 140:11 uses the same picture).
Psalm 18:13 has "his clouds passed through, hail and coals of fire"; this verse has "coals of fire burned", with the verb of verse 9, and no hail.

source.text: יַרְעֵ֥ם מִן־שָׁמַ֖יִם יְהוָ֑ה וְעֶלְי֖וֹן יִתֵּ֥ן קוֹלֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Thundered from heaven YHWH, and [the] Most High gave his voice.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} thundered from the heavens, \q and the Most High gave forth {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} thundered from heaven; \q the Most High raised {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} thundered from the sky. \q The God who is above all spoke with a voice like thunder.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tronó desde los cielos, \q y el Altísimo dio {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tronó desde el cielo; \q el Altísimo alzó {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tronó desde el cielo. \q El Dios que está por encima de todo habló con una voz como un trueno.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a tonné du haut des cieux, \q et le Très-Haut a fait retentir {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a tonné du haut du ciel ; \q le Très-Haut a élevé {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait gronder le tonnerre du haut du ciel. \q Le Dieu qui est au-dessus de tout a parlé d’une voix de tonnerre.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinguruma kutoka mbinguni, \q na Aliye Juu Kabisa akatoa sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinguruma kutoka mbinguni; \q Aliye Juu Kabisa alipaza sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinguruma kutoka angani. \q Mungu aliye juu ya wote alisema kwa sauti kama radi.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phát sấm từ các tầng trời, \q và Đấng Chí Cao cất tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phát sấm từ trời; \q Đấng Chí Cao cất tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phát sấm từ trên trời. \q Đức Chúa Trời ở trên hết mọi sự cất tiếng như sấm rền.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하늘에서 천둥을 치시고, \q 지극히 높으신 분께서 그분의 목소리를 내셨다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하늘에서 천둥을 울리시고, \q 지극히 높으신 분께서 목소리를 높이셨다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하늘에서 천둥을 치셨다. \q 모든 것 위에 계신 하나님께서 천둥 같은 목소리로 말씀하셨다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} trovejou desde os céus, \q e o Altíssimo fez soar a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} voz.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} trovejou do céu; \q o Altíssimo levantou a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} voz.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} trovejou lá do céu. \q O Deus que está acima de tudo falou com uma voz de trovão.

decisions.reason: God's voice is the thunder (Psalm 29:3-9).

decisions.choice: the Most High: God above all
decisions.reason: The title ('Elyon) names God as higher than every power in heaven and on earth (Genesis 14:18-20; Psalm 7:18).
Psalm 18:14 begins with "and", has "in the heavens" where this verse has "from heaven", and ends with "hail and coals of fire", words this verse does not have.

decisions.choice: The God who is above all
decisions.reason: Readable explains the title, as at Psalm 18:14.
Portuguese "deu a sua voz" would not be understood; "fez soar" is the plain Portuguese for making a voice heard, and keeps the noun "voz" (m1).

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח חִצִּ֖ים וַיְפִיצֵ֑ם בָּרָ֖ק וַיָּהֹֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he sent arrows and scattered them, lightning, and routed [them].

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sent out arrows and scattered them, \q lightning, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} routed [them].
en.B: He let arrows fly and scattered the enemy; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sent lightning and threw them into confusion.
en.R: He shot arrows and made the enemy run away. \q He sent lightning, and they did not know where to go.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} envió flechas y los dispersó, \q relámpagos, y los puso en fuga.
es.B: Disparó flechas y dispersó a los enemigos; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lanzó relámpagos y los llenó de confusión.
es.R: Disparó flechas e hizo huir al enemigo. \q Lanzó relámpagos, y no sabían adónde ir.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a lancé des flèches et les a dispersés, \q l’éclair, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [les] a mis en déroute.
fr.B: Il a décoché des flèches et dispersé l’ennemi ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a lancé l’éclair et les a jetés dans la confusion.
fr.R: Il a tiré des flèches et a fait fuir l’ennemi. \q Il a lancé des éclairs, et ils ne savaient plus où aller.

sw.L: Akatuma mishale akawatawanya, \q umeme, akawafadhaisha.
sw.B: Aliiachilia mishale akawatawanya adui; \q alituma umeme akawachanganya.
sw.R: Alipiga mishale akawafanya adui wakimbie. \q Alituma umeme, nao hawakujua waende wapi.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bắn tên ra và làm chúng tan tác, \q chớp nhoáng, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm [chúng] rối loạn.
vi.B: Ngài bắn tên ra và làm quân thù tan tác; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phóng tia chớp và làm chúng hoảng loạn.
vi.R: Ngài bắn tên ra và làm kẻ thù bỏ chạy. \q Ngài phóng chớp, và chúng không biết chạy đi đâu.

ko.L: 그분께서 화살들을 쏘아 그들을 흩으시고, \q 번개로 그들을 혼란에 빠뜨리셨다.
ko.B: 그분께서 화살을 날려 원수들을 흩으시고, \q 번개를 보내 그들을 혼란에 빠뜨리셨다.
ko.R: 그분께서 화살을 쏘셔서 원수들을 달아나게 하셨다. \q 번개를 보내시니 그들은 어디로 가야 할지 몰랐다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} enviou flechas e os dispersou, \q relâmpago, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [os] desbaratou.
pt.B: Ele disparou flechas e dispersou o inimigo; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mandou relâmpagos e os lançou em confusão.
pt.R: Ele atirou flechas e fez o inimigo fugir. \q Ele mandou relâmpagos, e os inimigos não sabiam para onde ir.

decisions.reason: The lightning bolts are God's arrows (Psalm 77:18; Habakkuk 3:11).

decisions.choice: lightning: a second thing he sent out
decisions.reason: The line is short: "lightning, and he routed". Lightning is the second weapon God sends, after the arrows.
The verb (hamam) is used of God throwing an army into confusion (Exodus 14:24; Joshua 10:10).

Psalm 18:15 has "his arrows" and "lightnings he shot" (rav); this verse has "arrows" and "lightning", without the verb. The last verb is written as in the psalm, "and he routed them", and marked to be read "and he routed", with the same sense.
"Them" are David's enemies, and the lightning is sent like the arrows; Balanced and Readable say so.

source.text: וַיֵּֽרָאוּ֙ אֲפִ֣קֵי יָ֔ם יִגָּל֖וּ מֹסְד֣וֹת תֵּבֵ֑ל בְּגַעֲרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מִנִּשְׁמַ֖ת ר֥וּחַ אַפּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And were seen [the] channels of [the] sea; were uncovered [the] foundations of [the] world at [the] rebuke of YHWH, at [the] blast of [the] breath of his nose.

en.L: And the channels of the sea appeared; \q the foundations of the world were laid bare \q at the rebuke of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q at the blast of the breath of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} nostrils.
en.B: The beds of the sea came into view; \q the world's foundations lay bare \q at the rebuke of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q at the blast of breath from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} nostrils.
en.R: The bottom of the sea could be seen. \q The deep roots of the earth were uncovered \q when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} shouted in anger and breathed out hard.

es.L: Y aparecieron los cauces del mar; \q quedaron al descubierto los cimientos del mundo \q ante la reprensión {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q ante el soplo del aliento de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nariz.
es.B: Se vio el lecho del mar; \q los cimientos del mundo quedaron al desnudo \q ante la reprensión {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q ante el soplo de aliento de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nariz.
es.R: Se podía ver el fondo del mar. \q Las raíces profundas de la tierra quedaron al descubierto \q cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} gritó con enojo y sopló con fuerza.

fr.L: Et les lits de la mer sont apparus ; \q les fondements du monde ont été mis à nu \q à la menace {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q au souffle du vent de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} narines.
fr.B: Le fond de la mer est apparu ; \q les fondations du monde ont été mises à nu \q à la menace {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q au souffle puissant de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} narines.
fr.R: On a pu voir le fond de la mer. \q Les racines profondes de la terre ont été découvertes \q quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a crié de colère et soufflé très fort.

sw.L: Mifereji ya bahari ikaonekana; \q misingi ya ulimwengu ikawa wazi \q kwa kukemea kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kwa pumzi ya puani {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}.
sw.B: Vitanda vya bahari vikaonekana; \q misingi ya dunia ikawa wazi \q kwa karipio la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kwa mvumo wa pumzi kutoka puani {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}.
sw.R: Sakafu ya bahari ikaonekana. \q Mizizi ya ndani ya dunia ikawa wazi \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipopiga kelele kwa hasira na kupumua kwa nguvu.

vi.L: Và các lòng biển hiện ra; \q các nền của thế gian bị phơi trần \q bởi lời quở trách của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q bởi hơi thở thổi ra từ lỗ mũi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Đáy biển hiện ra; \q nền móng thế gian bị phơi bày \q khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} quở trách, \q khi hơi thở từ lỗ mũi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thổi mạnh ra.
vi.R: Người ta có thể thấy đáy biển. \q Nền móng sâu của đất bị phơi ra \q khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi giận quát lên và thở mạnh ra.

ko.L: 바다의 물길들이 나타나고, \q 세상의 기초가 드러났다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 꾸짖음에, \q 그분 콧구멍의 숨결에 [그렇게 되었다].
ko.B: 바다의 밑바닥이 드러나고, \q 세상의 기초가 훤히 드러났다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 꾸짖으시고 \q 콧김을 세차게 내뿜으셨기 때문이다.
ko.R: 바다의 밑바닥이 보였다. \q 땅의 깊은 뿌리가 드러났다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 노하여 소리치시고 세차게 숨을 내쉬셨을 때였다.

pt.L: E apareceram os canais do mar; \q os fundamentos do mundo foram descobertos \q pela repreensão {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q pelo sopro do fôlego das {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} narinas.
pt.B: Os leitos do mar ficaram à vista; \q os fundamentos do mundo ficaram expostos \q diante da repreensão {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q diante do sopro das {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} narinas.
pt.R: O fundo do mar apareceu. \q As raízes profundas da terra ficaram descobertas \q quando {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} gritou com ira e soprou com força.

decisions.choice: the blast of his nostrils: as at the Red Sea
decisions.reason: At the sea "by the blast of your nostrils the waters piled up" (Exodus 15:8), and the seabed was laid bare. The rescue of David is told like the rescue at the sea.
God's rebuke (ge'arah) drives back the waters (Psalm 104:7).

Psalm 18:16 has "channels of water" where this verse has "channels of the sea". It speaks to God, "at your rebuke, LORD ... of your nostrils", where this verse speaks of him, "at the rebuke of the LORD ... of his nostrils".

decisions.choice: shouted in anger and breathed out hard
decisions.reason: Readable says what the rebuke and the blast of breath are, as at Psalm 18:16.
Here the Hebrew speaks of the LORD in the third person, where the psalm addresses him (m3); French follows the English.

decisions.choice: la reprensión del SEÑOR ... de su nariz
decisions.reason: Psalm 18:16 speaks to the LORD ('your rebuke'); here the Hebrew speaks of him ('the rebuke of the LORD, his nostrils'), so the Spanish turns the Psalm's words into the third person, as the English does.

decisions.choice: the verse speaks about the LORD in the plain style ("{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 꾸짖음", "그분 콧구멍")
decisions.reason: Psalm 18:16 speaks to God ("your rebuke"); Samuel's Hebrew speaks of him ("the rebuke of the LORD ... his nostrils"), so the Korean keeps the narrative style here.

decisions.choice: o sopro (do fôlego) das suas narinas
decisions.reason: The rescue is told like the crossing of the sea (m1), so the words are those of Exodus 15:8 in Portuguese, "o sopro das tuas narinas", here in the third person.

source.text: יִשְׁלַ֥ח מִמָּר֖וֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽמְשֵׁ֖נִי מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: He sent from on high, he took me; he drew me out of many waters.

en.L: He reached down from on high, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} took me; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} drew me out of many waters.
en.B: From on high {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stretched out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand and seized me; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} pulled me out of deep waters.
en.R: He reached down from heaven and grabbed me. \q He pulled me out of the deep water.

es.L: Extendió [la mano] desde lo alto, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me tomó; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me sacó de las muchas aguas.
es.B: Desde lo alto {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} extendió {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano y me agarró; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me sacó de las aguas profundas.
es.R: Bajó la mano desde el cielo y me agarró. \q Me sacó del agua profunda.

fr.L: Il a tendu [la main] d’en haut, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a pris ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a retiré des grandes eaux.
fr.B: D’en haut, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tendu {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main et m’a saisi ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a tiré des eaux profondes.
fr.R: Du ciel, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tendu la main et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a attrapé. \q Il m’a sorti de l’eau profonde.

sw.L: Alituma kutoka juu, akanichukua; \q akanitoa katika maji mengi.
sw.B: Kutoka juu alinyoosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} akanishika; \q akanivuta kutoka katika maji makuu.
sw.R: Alinyoosha mkono kutoka mbinguni akanishika. \q Akanivuta kutoka katika maji mengi.

vi.L: Ngài từ trên cao đưa tay xuống, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nắm lấy tôi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} kéo tôi ra khỏi nhiều dòng nước.
vi.B: Từ trên cao, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đưa tay ra nắm lấy tôi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} kéo tôi lên khỏi những dòng nước sâu.
vi.R: Ngài từ trời đưa tay xuống và nắm lấy tôi. \q Ngài kéo tôi lên khỏi dòng nước sâu.

ko.L: 그분께서 높은 곳에서 [손을] 뻗치셔서 나를 붙잡으시고, \q 많은 물에서 나를 건져 내셨다.
ko.B: 그분께서 높은 곳에서 손을 내미셔서 나를 붙드시고, \q 깊은 물속에서 나를 끌어내셨다.
ko.R: 그분께서 하늘에서 손을 뻗어 나를 붙잡으셨다. \q 깊은 물속에서 나를 끌어내셨다.

pt.L: Do alto {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} estendeu [a mão], {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me tomou; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me tirou de muitas águas.
pt.B: Do alto {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} estendeu a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão e me agarrou; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me tirou das águas profundas.
pt.R: Ele estendeu a mão lá do céu e me segurou. \q Ele me tirou da água funda.

decisions.choice: drew me out: the verb of Moses' name
decisions.reason: The verb (mashah) is found only here, in Psalm 18:17 and in Exodus 2:10, where Pharaoh's daughter names Moses because she "drew him out" of the water.

decisions.choice: many waters: the floods of death and danger
decisions.reason: The waters of verse 5; many waters are the forces of chaos and death (Psalm 32:6; 144:7).

decisions.choice: he sent: he reached out his hand
decisions.reason: "He sent" is short for "he sent out his hand" (Psalm 144:7).
Psalm 18:17 has the same words.
The verb is the one behind Moses' name (m1), and Exodus 2:10 in Portuguese says "eu o tirei das águas"; "tirar" is kept at every level so the echo can be heard.

source.text: יַצִּילֵ֕נִי מֵאֹיְבִ֖י עָ֑ז מִשֹּׂ֣נְאַ֔י כִּ֥י אָמְצ֖וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: He rescued me from my enemy, strong, from those who hated me, for they were stronger than I.

en.L: He rescued me from my strong enemy, \q from those who hated me, \q for they were too strong for me.
en.B: He snatched me away from my powerful enemy, \q from those who hated me, \q because they were stronger than I was.
en.R: He saved me from my powerful enemy and from all who hated me. \q They were too strong for me to fight.

es.L: Me libró de mi enemigo poderoso, \q de los que me odiaban, \q porque eran más fuertes que yo.
es.B: Me arrebató de mi enemigo poderoso, \q de los que me odiaban, \q porque eran más fuertes que yo.
es.R: Me salvó de mi enemigo poderoso y de todos los que me odiaban. \q Eran demasiado fuertes para que yo pudiera pelear con ellos.

fr.L: Il m’a délivré de mon ennemi puissant, \q de ceux qui me haïssaient, \q car ils étaient trop forts pour moi.
fr.B: Il m’a arraché à mon puissant ennemi, \q à ceux qui me haïssaient, \q parce qu’ils étaient plus forts que moi.
fr.R: Il m’a sauvé de mon ennemi puissant et de tous ceux qui me haïssaient. \q Ils étaient trop forts pour que je les combatte.

sw.L: Aliniokoa kutoka kwa adui yangu mwenye nguvu, \q kutoka kwa wale walionichukia, \q kwa maana walikuwa na nguvu kuliko mimi.
sw.B: Alininyakua kutoka kwa adui yangu mwenye nguvu, \q kutoka kwa wale walionichukia, \q kwa sababu walinizidi nguvu.
sw.R: Aliniokoa kutoka kwa adui yangu mwenye nguvu na kutoka kwa wote walionichukia. \q Walikuwa na nguvu mno kwangu kupigana nao.

vi.L: Ngài giải cứu tôi khỏi kẻ thù mạnh mẽ của tôi, \q khỏi những kẻ ghét tôi, \q vì chúng quá mạnh đối với tôi.
vi.B: Ngài giật tôi khỏi tay kẻ thù hùng mạnh, \q khỏi những kẻ ghét tôi, \q vì chúng mạnh hơn tôi.
vi.R: Ngài cứu tôi khỏi kẻ thù hùng mạnh và khỏi tất cả những kẻ ghét tôi. \q Chúng quá mạnh, tôi không thể chống lại.

ko.L: 그분께서 나를 내 강한 원수에게서, \q 나를 미워하는 자들에게서 건지셨으니, \q 그들이 나보다 강했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그분께서 나를 힘센 원수에게서, \q 나를 미워하는 자들에게서 낚아채 건지셨다. \q 그들은 나보다 강했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그분께서 힘센 원수에게서, 나를 미워하는 모든 사람에게서 나를 구해 주셨다. \q 그들은 너무 강해서 나 혼자서는 싸울 수 없었다.

pt.L: Ele me livrou do meu inimigo forte, \q daqueles que me odiavam, \q pois eram fortes demais para mim.
pt.B: Ele me arrancou das mãos do meu inimigo poderoso, \q daqueles que me odiavam, \q porque eram mais fortes do que eu.
pt.R: Ele me salvou do meu inimigo poderoso e de todos os que me odiavam. \q Eles eram fortes demais para eu enfrentá-los.

decisions.choice: my strong enemy: one enemy above all
decisions.reason: The singular "enemy" may be Saul (verse 1) or every enemy taken together.

decisions.choice: they were too strong for me: rescue by God alone
decisions.reason: David does not boast of his own strength; the rescue is God's work.
Psalm 18:18 has "and from those who hated me"; this verse has no "and". The sense is the same.

source.text: יְקַדְּמֻ֖נִי בְּי֣וֹם אֵידִ֑י וַיְהִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה מִשְׁעָ֖ן לִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: They confronted me in [the] day of my calamity, but YHWH was a support to me.

en.L: They confronted me in the day of my calamity, \q but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was a support to me.
en.B: They came at me on my day of disaster, \q but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} held me up.
en.R: They attacked me when I was in deep trouble. \q But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} took care of me.

es.L: Me salieron al encuentro en el día de mi desgracia, \q pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} fue mi apoyo.
es.B: Me atacaron en mi día de desastre, \q pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me sostuvo.
es.R: Me atacaron cuando yo estaba en grandes problemas. \q Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me cuidó.

fr.L: Ils m’ont affronté au jour de mon malheur, \q mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a été pour moi un appui.
fr.B: Ils sont venus contre moi au jour de mon désastre, \q mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a soutenu.
fr.R: Ils m’ont attaqué quand j’étais dans un grand malheur. \q Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a pris soin de moi.

sw.L: Walinikabili siku ya msiba wangu, \q lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawa tegemeo langu.
sw.B: Walinijia siku ya msiba wangu, \q lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinishika.
sw.R: Walinishambulia nilipokuwa katika taabu kubwa. \q Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinitunza.

vi.L: Chúng đối diện tôi trong ngày tai họa của tôi, \q nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là chỗ dựa cho tôi.
vi.B: Chúng xông vào tôi trong ngày tôi gặp tai họa, \q nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nâng đỡ tôi.
vi.R: Chúng tấn công tôi khi tôi đang gặp hoạn nạn lớn. \q Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chăm sóc tôi.

ko.L: 그들이 내 재앙의 날에 내게 닥쳤으나, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내게 의지할 지팡이가 되셨다.
ko.B: 내가 재난을 당한 날에 그들이 나를 덮쳤지만, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나를 붙들어 주셨다.
ko.R: 내가 큰 어려움에 빠졌을 때 그들이 나를 공격했다. \q 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나를 돌보아 주셨다.

pt.L: Eles me confrontaram no dia da minha calamidade, \q mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} foi um apoio para mim.
pt.B: Eles vieram contra mim no dia da minha desgraça, \q mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me sustentou.
pt.R: Eles me atacaram quando eu estava em grande dificuldade. \q Mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} cuidou de mim.

decisions.reason: The word ('ed) is a crushing disaster (Proverbs 1:26-27).

decisions.choice: support: a staff to lean on
decisions.reason: The word (mish'an) is something to lean on, like a staff (Psalm 23:4 uses a related word).
Psalm 18:19 has "became a support" (with "for"); this verse has "was a support". The sense is the same.

source.text: וַיֹּצֵ֥א לַמֶּרְחָ֖ב אֹתִ֑י יְחַלְּצֵ֖נִי כִּי־חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And he brought out to the broad place me; he rescued me, for he delighted in me.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brought me out into the broad place; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rescued me, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} delighted in me.
en.B: He led me out into open country; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} set me free, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was pleased with me.
en.R: He brought me out to a safe, open place. \q He saved me because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was happy with me.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me sacó a un lugar espacioso; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me libró, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se agradó de mí.
es.B: Me llevó a campo abierto; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me liberó, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estaba contento conmigo.
es.R: Me sacó a un lugar abierto y seguro. \q Me salvó porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estaba contento conmigo.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a fait sortir au large ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a délivré, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prenait plaisir en moi.
fr.B: Il m’a conduit en terrain dégagé ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a libéré, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était content de moi.
fr.R: Il m’a conduit dans un endroit sûr et ouvert. \q Il m’a sauvé parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était content de moi.

sw.L: Akanitoa nje mpaka mahali palipo wazi; \q akaniokoa, kwa maana alipendezwa nami.
sw.B: Aliniongoza nje mpaka nchi iliyo wazi; \q aliniweka huru, kwa sababu alipendezwa nami.
sw.R: Alinitoa mpaka mahali salama palipo wazi. \q Aliniokoa kwa sababu alifurahishwa nami.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đem tôi ra nơi rộng rãi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giải cứu tôi, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui thích nơi tôi.
vi.B: Ngài dẫn tôi ra nơi đồng rộng; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải thoát tôi, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hài lòng về tôi.
vi.R: Ngài đưa tôi ra một nơi rộng rãi và an toàn. \q Ngài cứu tôi vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui lòng về tôi.

ko.L: 그분께서 나를 넓은 곳으로 이끌어 내시고, \q 나를 건지셨으니, 그분께서 나를 기뻐하셨기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그분께서 나를 탁 트인 곳으로 이끌어 내시고, \q 나를 풀어 주셨다. 그분께서 나를 기뻐하셨기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그분께서 나를 안전하고 넓은 곳으로 데려가셨다. \q 나를 기뻐하셨기에 나를 구해 주셨다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me fez sair para o lugar espaçoso; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me livrou, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se agradou de mim.
pt.B: Ele me levou para campo aberto; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me libertou, porque se agradava de mim.
pt.R: Ele me levou para um lugar aberto e seguro. \q Ele me salvou porque estava contente comigo.

decisions.choice: the broad place: freedom and safety
decisions.reason: Trouble in Hebrew is a narrow place where one is hemmed in; rescue is room to move (Psalm 4:2; 118:5).

decisions.choice: he delighted in me: he was pleased with me
decisions.reason: The verb (chafets) is used of God's pleasure in a person (Psalm 22:9). David used it of himself when he fled from Absalom: "if he says, 'I have no pleasure in you'" (15:26).
Psalm 18:20 joins "me" to the verb "brought out"; here it stands as a separate word after "the broad place". The sense is the same.

source.text: יִגְמְלֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֖ה כְּצִדְקָתִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָדַ֖י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to [the] cleanness of my hands he repaid me.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} dealt with me according to my righteousness; \q according to the cleanness of my hands {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} repaid me.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} treated me as my right conduct deserved; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rewarded me because my hands were clean.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} was good to me because I did what was right. \q I had not done wrong, so {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} blessed me.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me trató conforme a mi justicia; \q conforme a la limpieza de mis manos {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me recompensó.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me trató como merecía mi buena conducta; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me recompensó porque mis manos estaban limpias.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} fue bueno conmigo porque hice lo correcto. \q Yo no había hecho nada malo, así que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me bendijo.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a traité selon ma justice ; \q selon la pureté de mes mains {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a rendu.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a traité comme le méritait ma droiture ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a récompensé parce que mes mains étaient pures.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a été bon pour moi parce que j’ai fait ce qui est juste. \q Je n’avais pas fait le mal, alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a béni.
