pt.R: Gente de outras terras se curva diante de mim, com medo. \q Assim que ouvem falar de mim, eles me obedecem.

decisions.choice: cringe: give false or forced submission
decisions.reason: The verb (kachash) means to deceive or deny; here it is the forced, insincere humility of the defeated (Psalm 66:3; Deuteronomy 33:29).
"Sons of" names a group by what it belongs to.
Psalm 18:45 has the two lines in the other order, and slightly different forms of "cringe" and "hearing". The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: se encolhem (L); vêm a mim rastejando (B)
decisions.reason: The verb names the forced, insincere submission of the defeated (m1); "rastejar" says that servile humility in plain Portuguese, where "bajular" would make it flattery only.

source.text: בְּנֵ֥י נֵכָ֖ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְיַחְגְּר֖וּ מִמִּסְגְּרוֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Sons of foreignness wither, and they gird themselves from their strongholds.

en.L: Sons of foreign lands wither, \q and they gird themselves [to come] out of their strongholds.
en.B: Foreigners lose heart; \q they put on their belts and come out of their fortresses.
en.R: They lose their courage. \q They get ready and come out of their hiding places to give up.

es.L: Los hijos de tierras extranjeras se marchitan, \q y se ciñen [para salir] de sus fortalezas.
es.B: Los extranjeros pierden el ánimo; \q se ciñen el cinturón y salen de sus fortalezas.
es.R: Pierden el valor. \q Se preparan y salen de sus escondites para rendirse.

fr.L: Les fils de l’étranger se fanent, \q et ils se ceignent [pour sortir] de leurs forteresses.
fr.B: Les étrangers perdent courage ; \q ils mettent leur ceinture et sortent de leurs forteresses.
fr.R: Ils perdent courage. \q Ils se préparent et sortent de leurs cachettes pour se rendre.

sw.L: Wana wa nchi za kigeni wanadhoofika, \q nao wanajifunga [ili kutoka] katika ngome zao.
sw.B: Wageni wanakata tamaa; \q wanajifunga mishipi na kutoka katika ngome zao.
sw.R: Wanakosa ujasiri. \q Wanajiandaa na kutoka katika maficho yao ili kujisalimisha.

vi.L: Con cái của các xứ ngoại bang héo hon, \q và chúng thắt lưng [đi] ra khỏi đồn lũy của chúng.
vi.B: Người ngoại quốc mất hết can đảm; \q họ thắt lưng và bước ra khỏi đồn lũy của mình.
vi.R: Họ mất hết can đảm. \q Họ sửa soạn và ra khỏi nơi ẩn nấp để đầu hàng.

ko.L: 이방의 아들들이 시들어, \q 그들의 요새에서 [나오려고] 띠를 띱니다.
ko.B: 이방 사람들은 기가 꺾여, \q 허리띠를 매고 자기들의 요새에서 나옵니다.
ko.R: 그들은 용기를 잃었습니다. \q 그들은 항복하려고 채비를 하고 숨어 있던 곳에서 나옵니다.

pt.L: Filhos de terras estrangeiras murcham, \q e se cingem [para sair] das suas fortalezas.
pt.B: Os estrangeiros perdem o ânimo; \q eles apertam o cinto e saem das suas fortalezas.
pt.R: Eles perdem a coragem. \q Eles se preparam e saem dos seus esconderijos para se render.

decisions.choice: they gird themselves: they get ready to come out
decisions.reason: The verb (chagar) normally means to tie on a belt, to get ready to go out. Here the defeated foreigners make ready and leave their strongholds to surrender. Others take it as a rare word meaning "limp", or read the verb of Psalm 18:46, "they come trembling".
Like a plant drying up, their courage fails (Exodus 18:18 uses the same verb).
Psalm 18:46 has "they come trembling" (yachregu) where this verse has "they gird themselves" (yachgeru), the same letters in another order.
Readable says why they come out (m1).

source.text: חַי־יְהוָ֖ה וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י וְיָרֻ֕ם אֱלֹהֵ֖י צ֥וּר יִשְׁעִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Living [is] YHWH, and blessed [be] my rock, and may be exalted [the] God of [the] rock of my salvation,

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} lives! And blessed [be] my rock, \q and may the God of the rock of my salvation be exalted,
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is alive! Blessed be my rock! \q May God, the rock who saves me, be lifted high,
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is alive! Praise God, who is my rock! \q Praise God, the rock who saves me!

es.L: ¡Vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! Y bendita [sea] mi roca, \q y sea exaltado el Dios de la roca de mi salvación,
es.B: ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vive! ¡Bendita sea mi roca! \q Que sea enaltecido Dios, la roca que me salva,
es.R: ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está vivo! ¡Alabado sea Dios, que es mi roca! \q ¡Alabado sea Dios, la roca que me salva!

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant ! Et béni [soit] mon rocher, \q et que le Dieu du rocher de mon salut soit exalté,
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant ! Béni soit mon rocher ! \q Que Dieu, le rocher qui me sauve, soit élevé bien haut,
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant ! Louez Dieu, mon rocher ! \q Louez Dieu, le rocher qui me sauve !

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yu hai! Na mwamba wangu abarikiwe, \q na Mungu wa mwamba wa wokovu wangu atukuzwe,
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yu hai! Mwamba wangu na abarikiwe! \q Mungu, mwamba anayeniokoa, na ainuliwe juu,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yu hai! Msifuni Mungu, aliye mwamba wangu! \q Msifuni Mungu, mwamba anayeniokoa!

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống! Và đáng chúc tụng thay vầng đá của tôi, \q và nguyện Đức Chúa Trời, vầng đá cứu rỗi của tôi, được tôn cao,
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống! Chúc tụng vầng đá của tôi! \q Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời, vầng đá giải cứu tôi, được tôn cao,
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang sống! Hãy ca ngợi Đức Chúa Trời, vầng đá của tôi! \q Hãy ca ngợi Đức Chúa Trời, vầng đá cứu tôi!

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계신다! 나의 반석은 송축을 받으시고, \q 내 구원의 반석이신 하나님께서 높임을 받으시기를,
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계신다! 나의 반석을 송축하여라! \q 나를 구원하시는 반석이신 하나님께서 높임을 받으시기를!
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계신다! 나의 반석이신 하나님을 찬양하여라! \q 나를 구원하시는 반석이신 하나님을 찬양하여라!

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vive! E bendita [seja] a minha rocha, \q e seja exaltado o Deus da rocha da minha salvação,
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vive! Bendita seja a minha rocha! \q Seja exaltado Deus, a rocha que me salva,
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} está vivo! Louvado seja Deus, a minha rocha! \q Louvado seja Deus, a rocha que me salva!

decisions.choice: The LORD lives: the living God
decisions.reason: The words are used in oaths ("as the LORD lives", 1 Samuel 14:39); here they are a shout of praise. The LORD, unlike idols, is alive and acts (Jeremiah 10:10).
To bless God is to praise him and speak well of him (Psalm 16:7).
The praise continues through verse 49, so this verse ends with a comma.
Psalm 18:47 has "the God of my salvation"; this verse has "the God of the rock of my salvation", taking up "rock" from the line before (compare verse 3).

"Vive" is the word of the oath "Tão certo como vive o SENHOR" (m1; 1 Samuel 14:39), so Literal and Balanced keep it and the shout can be heard as that oath turned to praise; Readable says "está vivo", as the English does.

source.text: הָאֵ֕ל הַנֹּתֵ֥ן נְקָמֹ֖ת לִ֑י וּמוֹרִ֥יד עַמִּ֖ים תַּחְתֵּֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: the God who gives vengeances for me, and bringing down peoples under me,

en.L: the God who gives vengeance for me \q and brings down peoples under me,
en.B: the God who avenges me \q and brings nations down beneath me,
en.R: God punishes my enemies for me. \q He brings nations down under my rule.

es.L: el Dios que me da venganza \q y hace bajar pueblos debajo de mí,
es.B: el Dios que me venga \q y abate naciones bajo mis pies,
es.R: Dios castiga a mis enemigos por mí. \q Él pone a las naciones bajo mi gobierno.

fr.L: le Dieu qui me donne vengeance \q et qui fait descendre les peuples sous moi,
fr.B: le Dieu qui me venge \q et qui abaisse les nations sous moi,
fr.R: Dieu punit mes ennemis pour moi. \q Il soumet les nations à mon autorité.

sw.L: Mungu anayenilipia kisasi \q na kuwashusha watu chini yangu,
sw.B: Mungu anayenilipizia kisasi \q na kuyashusha mataifa chini yangu,
sw.R: Mungu huwaadhibu adui zangu kwa ajili yangu. \q Huyashusha mataifa chini ya utawala wangu.

vi.L: là Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng báo thù cho tôi \q và hạ các dân xuống dưới tôi,
vi.B: là Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng báo thù cho tôi \q và hạ các dân tộc xuống dưới quyền tôi,
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời trừng phạt kẻ thù cho tôi. \q Ngài hạ các dân tộc xuống dưới quyền cai trị của tôi.

ko.L: 나를 위해 원수를 갚아 주시고 \q 민족들을 내 아래로 끌어내리시는 하나님,
ko.B: 나를 위해 원수를 갚아 주시고 \q 민족들을 내 아래로 끌어내리시는 하나님,
ko.R: 하나님께서는 나를 위해 내 원수들을 벌하신다. \q 민족들을 끌어내려 내 다스림 아래 두신다.

pt.L: o Deus que me dá vingança \q e faz descer povos debaixo de mim,
pt.B: o Deus que me vinga \q e faz as nações se abaterem debaixo de mim,
pt.R: Deus castiga os meus inimigos por mim. \q Ele põe as nações debaixo do meu domínio.

decisions.reason: Vengeance (neqamah) belongs to God (Deuteronomy 32:35). David does not take it for himself; God gives it, setting right the wrong done to him.
Psalm 18:48 has "and has subdued (yadber) peoples under me" where this verse has "and brings down (morid) peoples under me".

source.text: וּמוֹצִיאִ֖י מֵאֹֽיְבָ֑י וּמִקָּמַי֙ תְּר֣וֹמְמֵ֔נִי מֵאִ֥ישׁ חֲמָסִ֖ים תַּצִּילֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: and bringing me out from my enemies, and above those who rise against me you exalt me; from a man of violences you rescue me.

en.L: and who brings me out from my enemies; \q and above those who rise against me {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} exalt me; \q from a man of violence {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} rescue me.
en.B: who brings me out from among my enemies. \q You raise me high above my attackers; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} save me from the violent man.
en.R: He brings me safely away from my enemies. \q You lift me high above people who attack me. You save me from the violent man.

es.L: y que me saca de entre mis enemigos; \q sí, sobre los que se levantan contra mí {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me exaltas; \q del hombre violento {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me rescatas.
es.B: que me saca de en medio de mis enemigos. \q Tú me levantas muy por encima de mis atacantes; \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me salvas del hombre violento.
es.R: Él me saca a salvo de en medio de mis enemigos. \q Tú me levantas muy por encima de los que me atacan. Tú me salvas del hombre violento.

fr.L: et qui me fait sortir [du milieu] de mes ennemis ; \q oui, au-dessus de ceux qui se dressent contre moi {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’élèves ; \q de l’homme violent {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me délivres.
fr.B: qui me fait sortir du milieu de mes ennemis. \q Tu m’élèves bien au-dessus de mes agresseurs ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me sauves de l’homme violent.
fr.R: Il m’emmène loin de mes ennemis, en sécurité. \q Tu m’élèves bien au-dessus de ceux qui m’attaquent. Tu me sauves de l’homme violent.

sw.L: anayenitoa kutoka kwa adui zangu; \q naam, juu ya wale walioniinukia unaniinua; \q kutoka kwa mtu wa jeuri unaniponya.
sw.B: anayenitoa kutoka katikati ya adui zangu. \q Unaniinua juu ya washambuliaji wangu; \q unaniokoa kutoka kwa mtu mwenye jeuri.
sw.R: Ananitoa salama mbali na adui zangu. \q Unaniinua juu kuliko watu wanaonishambulia. Unaniokoa kutoka kwa mtu mwenye jeuri.

vi.L: và là Đấng đem tôi ra khỏi các kẻ thù của tôi; \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nâng tôi lên cao hơn những kẻ nổi lên chống tôi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu tôi khỏi người hung bạo.
vi.B: Đấng đem tôi ra khỏi vòng vây của kẻ thù. \q Ngài nâng tôi lên cao hơn những kẻ tấn công tôi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứu tôi khỏi kẻ hung bạo.
vi.R: Ngài đưa tôi thoát khỏi kẻ thù an toàn. \q Ngài nâng tôi lên cao hơn những kẻ tấn công tôi. Ngài cứu tôi khỏi kẻ hung bạo.

ko.L: 나를 내 원수들에게서 이끌어 내시는 [분이시다]. \q 주님께서는 저를 치려고 일어나는 자들 위로 저를 높이시고, \q 폭력의 사람에게서 저를 건지십니다.
ko.B: 나를 원수들 가운데서 이끌어 내시는 분이시다. \q 주님께서는 저를 공격하는 자들 위로 저를 높이 들어 올리시고, \q 폭력을 휘두르는 사람에게서 저를 구해 주십니다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 원수들에게서 나를 안전하게 이끌어 내신다. \q 주님께서는 저를 공격하는 사람들보다 저를 높이 들어 올리십니다. 폭력을 휘두르는 사람에게서 저를 구해 주십니다.

pt.L: e que me faz sair do meio dos meus inimigos; \q e acima dos que se levantam contra mim {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me exaltas; \q de um homem de violência {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me livras.
pt.B: que me tira do meio dos meus inimigos. \q Tu me levantas bem acima dos que me atacam; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me livras do homem violento.
pt.R: Ele me leva em segurança para longe dos meus inimigos. \q Tu me levantas bem acima das pessoas que me atacam. Tu me livras do homem violento.

decisions.choice: a man of violence: perhaps Saul
decisions.reason: The singular may point to one enemy, Saul (verse 1), or stand for every violent enemy (Psalm 140:2, 5). The plural "violences" means violence upon violence.
As in verse 29, the song turns from speaking of God to speaking to him.

Psalm 18:49 has "delivering me" (mefalleti) where this verse has "bringing me out" (motsi'i), "indeed above" where this verse has "and above", and "a man of violence" where this verse has the plural "violences".

source.text: עַל־כֵּ֛ן אוֹדְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וּלְשִׁמְךָ֖ אֲזַמֵּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore I will thank you, YHWH, among [the] nations, and to your name I will sing praises.

en.L: Therefore I will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, among the nations, \q and to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name I will sing praises.
en.B: That is why I will give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thanks, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, among the nations, \q and sing praise to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name.
en.R: So, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in front of people from every nation. \q I will sing praises to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

es.L: Por tanto {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daré gracias, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, entre las naciones, \q y a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre cantaré alabanzas.
es.B: Por eso {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daré gracias, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, entre las naciones, \q y cantaré alabanzas a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre.
es.R: Así que, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daré gracias delante de gente de todas las naciones. \q Cantaré alabanzas para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendrai grâce parmi les nations, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q et je chanterai {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom.
fr.B: Voilà pourquoi je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendrai grâce parmi les nations, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q et je chanterai la louange de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom.
fr.R: Alors, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercierai devant des gens de toutes les nations. \q Je chanterai {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} louanges.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo nitakushukuru kati ya mataifa, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} nitaimba sifa.
sw.B: Ndiyo maana nitakushukuru kati ya mataifa, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na kuliimbia sifa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakushukuru mbele ya watu wa kila taifa. \q Nitakuimbia {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} sifa.

vi.L: Vì vậy tôi sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, giữa các dân tộc, \q và tôi sẽ ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vì thế tôi sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, giữa các dân tộc, \q và hát ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Vậy, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trước mặt người của mọi dân tộc. \q Tôi sẽ hát ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 민족들 가운데서 주님께 감사하고, \q 주님의 이름을 찬양하겠습니다.
ko.B: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 민족들 가운데서 주님께 감사를 드리고, \q 주님의 이름을 노래하며 찬양하겠습니다.
ko.R: 그러니 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저는 모든 민족의 사람들 앞에서 주님께 감사드리겠습니다. \q 주님께 찬양을 부르겠습니다.

pt.L: Por isso eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} darei graças, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, entre as nações, \q e ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome cantarei louvores.
pt.B: Por isso eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} darei graças, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, entre as nações, \q e cantarei louvores ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome.
pt.R: Por isso, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agradecerei diante de gente de todas as nações. \q Cantarei louvores a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

decisions.choice: among the nations: quoted in Romans 15:9
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line to show that Scripture foresaw people of every nation praising God through Christ (Romans 15:9).

decisions.choice: your name: God himself as he has made himself known
decisions.reason: The name stands for the person, and for all God has shown himself to be (Exodus 3:13-15).
Psalm 18:50 has "among the nations" before "LORD", and "I will sing praises" in a slightly longer form. The sense is the same.
Readable says "you" for "your name" (m2), as at Psalm 18:50.

decisions.choice: Por isso ... entre as nações ... cantarei louvores ao teu nome
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line in Romans 15:9 (m1), so the Portuguese keeps the words of Romans 15:9 in Portuguese wherever the Hebrew allows: "Por isso", "entre as nações" and "cantarei louvores ao teu nome". The verb here is "darei graças", for the Hebrew "thank", as the English says "thank"; Romans has "louvarei" for Paul's Greek "praise".

source.text: מִגְדּ֖וֹל יְשׁוּע֣וֹת מַלְכּ֑וֹ וְעֹֽשֶׂה־חֶ֧סֶד לִמְשִׁיח֛וֹ לְדָוִ֥ד וּלְזַרְע֖וֹ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: [A] tower of salvations [to] his king, and doing loyal love to his anointed, to David and to his offspring forever.

en.L: [He is] a tower of salvations [for] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} king, \q and showing loyal love to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anointed, to David and to his offspring forever."
en.B: He is a tower of victories for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} king; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} keeps faith in loyal love with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anointed one, with David and his line for all time."
en.R: He is like a strong tower that gives {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} king great victories. \q He always shows faithful love to the king {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} chose, David, and to his children and grandchildren forever."

es.L: [Él es] torre de salvaciones [para] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rey, \q y muestra amor leal a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ungido, a David y a su descendencia para siempre».
es.B: Él es torre de victorias para {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rey; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mantiene {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ungido, con David y su descendencia por todos los tiempos».
es.R: Él es como una torre fuerte que le da a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rey grandes victorias. \q Siempre muestra {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel al rey que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} escogió, David, y a sus hijos y nietos para siempre».

fr.L: [Il est] une tour de victoires [pour] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} roi, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} montre l’amour loyal à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} oint, à David et à sa descendance pour toujours. »
fr.B: Il est une tour de victoires pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} roi ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} garde {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle envers {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} oint, envers David et sa lignée, pour tous les temps. »
fr.R: Il est comme une tour solide qui donne à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} roi de grandes victoires. \q Il montre toujours {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle au roi qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisi, à David, à ses enfants et à ses petits-enfants, pour toujours. »

sw.L: [Yeye ni] mnara wa wokovu [kwa] mfalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q na kumtendea upendo usiokoma masihi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, Daudi na uzao wake milele."
sw.B: Yeye ni mnara wa ushindi kwa mfalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; \q anaonyesha upendo usiokoma kwa yule aliyempaka mafuta, kwa Daudi na uzao wake nyakati zote."
sw.R: Yeye ni kama mnara imara unaompa mfalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ushindi mkubwa. \q Daima huonyesha upendo usiokoma kwa mfalme aliyemchagua, Daudi, na kwa watoto na wajukuu wake milele."

vi.L: [Ngài là] ngọn tháp cứu rỗi [cho] vua của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín với người được xức dầu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, với Đa-vít và với dòng dõi người đến đời đời."
vi.B: Ngài là ngọn tháp chiến thắng cho vua của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữ trọn tình yêu thương thành tín với người được xức dầu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, với Đa-vít và dòng dõi người đến muôn đời."
vi.R: Ngài như ngọn tháp vững chắc ban cho vua của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} những chiến thắng lớn. \q Ngài luôn bày tỏ tình thương không hề thay đổi với vị vua {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn, là Đa-vít, và với con cháu người mãi mãi."

ko.L: [그분은] 그분의 왕에게 구원의 망대이시며, \q 그분의 기름 부음 받은 이, 다윗과 그의 자손에게 영원히 한결같은 사랑을 베푸신다."
ko.B: 그분은 그분의 왕에게 승리의 망대이시다. \q 그분께서 그분의 기름 부음 받은 이, 다윗과 그의 자손에게 영원토록 한결같은 사랑으로 신실하게 대하신다."
ko.R: 그분께서는 강한 망대처럼 그분의 왕에게 큰 승리를 주신다. \q 그분께서 택하신 왕 다윗과 그의 자손에게 영원히 변함없는 사랑을 보여 주신다."

decisions.choice: a tower: the word as read, not as written
alternatives: making great the victories of his king (as written, and as Psalm 18:51)
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text read "making great" (magdil), as in Psalm 18:51, and the form marked to be read aloud is "tower" (migdol). The words follow the form to be read: God is a strong tower for his king (Proverbs 18:10).
The plural of yeshu'ah, salvation, here means acts of rescue, victories in battle (8:6, 14).

decisions.choice: his anointed, David and his offspring forever: the promise to David
decisions.reason: The king anointed by God (1 Samuel 16:13) is David, and the song ends with God's promise of a lasting line (7:12-16). "Anointed" (mashiach) is the word behind "Messiah" and "Christ", and the promise was later understood to point to the Messiah.

decisions.choice: loyal love: the faithful love God promised David
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is love that keeps its commitments. God promised that his chesed would not depart from David's son (7:15).
Psalm 18:51 reads "making great" (magdil) where this verse reads "tower" (migdol) (m1). The rest of the verse is the same.

This song is Psalm 18, and its wording is kept the same as the psalm wherever the Hebrew is the same. Psalm 18:51 has "loyal love" at Literal and Balanced and "faithful love" at Readable, so this verse does too, although elsewhere in 2 Samuel chesed is "steadfast love" at Literal and "faithful love" at Balanced (7:15).
Readable says what anointing meant: choosing someone as king.

alternatives: "il rend grandes les victoires", as Psalm 18:51
decisions.reason: The Hebrew as read here has "a tower" where the psalm has "he makes great" (m1); French follows the English.

The English keeps 'loyal love' at Balanced here (r-en-1), as the Psalms terms note has 'amor leal' at Literal and Balanced; Readable says 'amor fiel'. 'Torre de victorias' follows the English, where Psalm 18:51 has 'he makes great'.

Elsewhere in this block *ḥesed* is "fadhili" at Balanced and Readable, as the Samuel terms note sets; here the line reuses the published Swahili Psalm 18:51, which has "upendo usiokoma" at every level, since the Hebrew is the same. A reviewer should decide whether the song keeps the Psalm's wording or the book's.

decisions.reason: Here the read Hebrew text has "tower" where Psalm 18:51 has "makes great"; Swahili follows it with "mnara", as the English does.

decisions.reason: As the published Vietnamese Psalm 18:51, which this verse repeats; God's *ḥesed* keeps the Psalms wording.

decisions.choice: "구원의 망대" (L), "승리의 망대" (B, R), with the Psalm's words for *ḥesed* ("한결같은 사랑", R "변함없는 사랑") and "기름 부음 받은 이"
decisions.reason: Samuel's Hebrew reads "a tower of salvations" where the Psalm reads "he makes great the salvations". The words for *ḥesed* and "his anointed" stay those of the published Psalm 18, so that the song reads the same in both books, rather than the forms used elsewhere in 1 and 2 Samuel.

decisions.choice: amor leal (every level); o seu ungido (L, B); o rei que ele ungiu (R)
decisions.reason: God's chesed to David (m4) is "amor leal" at every level, the wording of the promise in 7:15 in Portuguese, where the English Readable says "faithful love". "Ungido" (L, B) and "o rei que ele ungiu" (R) follow the wording fixed for the whole of 1 and 2 Samuel (1 Samuel 2:10), so the song's last line echoes Hannah's; the English Readable says "chose".
